summary: A versioned UE 5.8.1 read-only benchmark now measures repeated C++ batch calls with explicit dataset provenance, timing statistics, stable result counts, limitations, and in-run uasset integrity evidence.
evidence: contracts/benchmark.v1.schema.json defines the benchmark artifact and requires limitations
artifacts/host-validation/ue-5.8.1-readonly-benchmark.json records 64 sorted Engine Static Meshes, two warmups, and seven timed repetitions
The measured warm-cache median was 0.5483 ms and nearest-rank P95 was 0.5968 ms for one 64-asset C++ call
All seven repetitions returned 64 collected assets and zero failures
SHA-256 before/after comparison inside the host run covered all 64 selected uassets and records unchanged=true
22 tests, Ruff, and goal-state audit passed before advancement
unresolvedRisks: The warm-cache Engine-content baseline does not represent cold startup or production assets
The public orchestration path does not yet bound C++ call size or expose progress/cancellation
UE 5.4 and UE 5.5 compatibility remains unverified
